description: This file defines the LicenseService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage License entities such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and checking existence.

classes.name: LicenseService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing license entities, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves a license object to the database, either as a new record or update.

methods.name: getLicenseDao
methods.description: Returns the LicenseDao object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a license entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a license entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of licenses based on search filters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of licenses matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes licenses specified by an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license name already exists, case-insensitive.
